name: Formalization admission / interpretive-artifact provenance (AX-01 boundary, AX-12) — dimension ADDED per CA P1-4: DIM-02 admits source BYTES; nothing previously governed how the committed formal RULEBASE — the single highest-risk artifact in every admissible class — comes into being and is contested. These are admission mechanisms, distinct from DIM-06 assurance and DIM-13 falsification; classes differ materially on them, and the taxonomy can now express e.g. that a K-CAT instance running on government-published formal law occupies a strictly different trust cell than one running on privately authored formalizations of the same statutes
families: human-authoritative-codification: expert-authored formal rulebase; each rule admitted under a signed record binding it to its NL source span and to the human authority asserting the mapping (the H1-conformant floor: the NL-to-formal mapping enters only as attested, admitted input whose certificate records who asserted it)

publisher-authoritative-formal-law: the formalization is itself the legally operative artifact (Catala at DGFiP-class) — dissolves the interpretive gap for covered law; the only family that raises the AX-01 MODEL_RELATIVE ceiling's PRACTICAL reach, because the committed model coincides with the legally binding text
llm-autoformalize-human-gate: LLM proposes formalizations strictly as untrusted candidates; a human authority reviews and signs admission (the GDPR-formalization line, arXiv 2604.14607)

n-version-formalization-admission: independently generated formalizations of the same provision SAT-diffed BEFORE admission; behavioral disagreement is a typed ambiguity/escalation object that blocks admission ('By Their Fruits' as an admission mechanism — distinct from its DIM-13 falsification use over already-admitted artifacts)

round-trip-verbalization-invariant: committed verbalization of the admitted rulebase with machine-checked round-trip drift detection as a STANDING admission invariant, re-run on every rulebase change ('Know Your Limits' line)

eliminations.retained_representative: K-COM and K-AGT (model-internal interpretation stands in for a rulebase)
eliminations.lemma: Violates H1: the NL-to-formal mapping enters the trusted path solely on a statistical model's authority, with no attested admission record — the mapping IS a trusted model output, exactly the escape hatch the AX-01 guarantee profile closes ('a statistical model cannot be trusted to certify the NL-to-formal mapping'). Retained representatives K-COM and K-AGT carry it in D_T.
